children: UK AI healthcare software provider's Q3 2026 revenue grew 14% yr/yr, driven by subscriptions and launches
Adjusted EBITDA for Q3 fell 8% yr/yr, reflecting investment in North America and new products
Company repurchased 47,236 shares for EUR 36k during Q3 2026
Company to monetise RTM trials, commercialise Educational Modules in Q4, and expand EMR ahead of 2027
Physitrack aims to bring US metropolitan health system live in Q4 and complete academic system contract
Medium-term target for EBITDA margin remains at 40–45%
SUBSCRIPTION REVENUE - Co said recurring SaaS subscriptions accounted for 94% of group revenue, supporting growth
INVESTMENT IN NORTH AMERICA AND PRODUCT LAUNCHES - Co said lower adjusted EBITDA margin reflected deliberate investment in North American commercial team and product launches
PRICE INCREASE AND LOW CHURN - Co said May price increase was absorbed by customers without rise in churn, supporting revenue and pricing power
